sources.shortCitation: Stare Melodie, “Może tak, może nie” — Columbia DM 1624 a (1932)
sources.fullCitation: Stare Melodie. “Może tak, może nie.” Polish-language song entry with words by Julian Tuwim and a recording by Zofia Terné, Columbia DM 1624 a, matrix WJ 277, 1932; linked on the page to “Gib nur acht, über Nacht kommt die Liebe.”
sources.title: Może tak, może nie — Columbia DM 1624 a
sources.creator: Stare Melodie
sources.researchNote: The page groups Fritz Rotter and Bronisław Kaper under music. The work-level credits follow contemporary German registrations, which assign the music to Kaper and the German words to Rotter.

sources.shortCitation: European Film Fund donor list, 1 May 1941–30 April 1942 — Kaper and Kohner entries
sources.fullCitation: Stiftung Deutsche Kinemathek – Museum für Film und Fernsehen, Sammlung Paul Kohner Agency. “Spendenliste von Mitgliedern des European Film Fund zwischen dem 1. Mai 1941 und dem 30. April 1942.” Typescript list of 69 members and their donations; entries include “Kaper, Bronislaw” ($120) and “Kohner, Paul” ($213). Presented in Künste im Exil, Deutsche Nationalbibliothek.
sources.title: European Film Fund donor list, 1 May 1941–30 April 1942
sources.creator: European Film Fund
